# Third-party sources (vendored, unmodified unless noted)

| Library | Version | License | Built as |
|---|---|---|---|
| [libusb](https://github.com/libusb/libusb) | 1.0.30 (2026-05) | LGPL-2.1 (`libusb/COPYING`) | its own shared library `libusb1.0.so`, so it can be replaced (LGPL §6) |
| [libuvc](https://github.com/libuvc/libuvc) | 0.0.8 (2026-09) | BSD (`libuvc/LICENSE.txt`) | static, inside `libhdmicapture.so` |

Only the files the Android build needs are copied: libusb's core + Linux usbfs backend + `android/config.h`; libuvc's `src/` without `frame-mjpeg.c` (we decode MJPEG ourselves). `libuvc_config.h` is generated by hand from `libuvc_config.h.in`.

To update: download the release tarballs, copy the same file list over, rebuild, and update this table and the in-app notices.
